facts.fact: Adwave's page says a TV commercial can run on streaming platforms like Hulu, Roku, and Peacock for as little as $50.
facts.quote: You can have a TV commercial running on streaming platforms like Hulu, Roku, and Peacock for as little as $50.

facts.fact: Adwave's page lists streaming TV media costs as starting at a $30-a-day minimum.
facts.quote: Media: Starting at $30-a-day minimum

facts.fact: Adwave's page states that AI-powered production through Adwave costs $0 because Adwave creates the ad free.
facts.quote: Production: $0 with AI-powered tools (Adwave creates your ad free)

facts.fact: Adwave's page cites traditional TV production costs of $5,000-$50,000+ for a professionally shot commercial.
facts.quote: Production: $5,000-$50,000+ for a professionally shot commercial

facts.fact: Adwave's page cites traditional TV media buying as often requiring $10,000+ minimum commitments.
facts.quote: Media buying: Often $10,000+ minimum commitments

facts.fact: Adwave's page says a $50-$100 budget is a testing budget that gives a few thousand impressions over a week or two.
facts.quote: $50-$100:** Testing the waters. A few thousand impressions over a week or two.

facts.fact: Adwave's page says a $100-$500 budget gets thousands of impressions in a first campaign.
facts.quote: A $100-$500 budget gets you thousands of impressions

facts.fact: Adwave's page describes a $1,000-$2,500 budget as serious local presence with multiple weeks of consistent exposure.
facts.quote: **$1,000-$2,500:** Serious local presence. Multiple weeks of consistent exposure.

facts.fact: Adwave's page says most viewers need 3-7 exposures to an ad before taking action.
facts.quote: Most viewers need 3-7 exposures before taking action

facts.fact: Adwave's page says results for a first campaign often appear gradually over 2-4 weeks.
facts.quote: Results often appear gradually over 2-4 weeks

facts.fact: Adwave's page says most local service businesses start with a 10-15 mile geographic targeting radius.
facts.quote: Most local service businesses start with a 10-15 mile radius.

facts.fact: Adwave's page says that with AI creation the commercial takes 2-5 minutes to produce and costs nothing beyond running the ad.
facts.quote: Time required: 2-5 minutes. Cost: Free (you only pay to run the ad).

facts.fact: Adwave's page says local professional production typically costs $5,000-$25,000 and takes 4-8 weeks from concept to finished ad.
facts.quote: $5,000-$25,000 for local production

facts.fact: Adwave's page says professional local production takes 4-8 weeks from concept to finished ad.
facts.quote: 4-8 weeks from concept to finished ad

facts.fact: Adwave's page lists DIY uploaded video requirements of 15 or 30 seconds in length and 1080p minimum resolution.
facts.quote: 15 or 30 seconds in length

facts.fact: Adwave's page says its streaming TV advertising runs across 100+ premium channels.
facts.quote: Streaming TV advertising runs across [100+ premium channels]

facts.fact: Adwave's page says prime time (7-11 PM) has the highest viewership but also the highest demand.
facts.quote: Prime time (7-11 PM) has the highest viewership but also highest demand

facts.fact: Adwave's page says a launched ad begins appearing on streaming platforms within 24-48 hours.
facts.quote: begins appearing on streaming platforms in 24-48 hours

facts.fact: Adwave's dashboard shows campaign performance in real time, including impressions, spend, and an interactive map of where the audience watched.
facts.quote: Adwave's dashboard](https://adwave.com/features/) shows your campaign performance in real-time, including impressions, spend, and an interactive map of where your audience watched.

facts.fact: Adwave's guide recommends a minimum campaign length of 2-4 weeks to see meaningful impact from a first TV ad.
facts.quote: Plan for a 2-4 week minimum campaign to see meaningful impact.

facts.fact: Adwave states that with its AI-powered platform a professional TV commercial can be generated in about 2 minutes.
facts.quote: you can generate a professional TV commercial in about 2 minutes.

facts.fact: Adwave states that traditional TV ad production takes weeks and costs thousands of dollars.
facts.quote: Traditional production takes weeks and costs thousands, but modern tools have dramatically shortened the process.

facts.fact: Adwave's guide suggests a test campaign of $50 to $100 as a starting budget for a first TV campaign.
facts.quote: A $50 to $100 test campaign gives you enough data to see if TV advertising works for your business

facts.fact: Adwave's guide advises checking a campaign at least weekly.
facts.quote: Check your campaign at least weekly.

facts.fact: Adwave's guide says a 30-second TV ad should focus on problem, solution, and call to action.
facts.quote: Don't try to cram everything about your business into 30 seconds. A simple structure works well: problem, solution (you), call to action.
